name: capture_uncovers_clash
ref: spec §2.5: no action may produce a clash, including clashes uncovered by vacating a square
note: Lily/1 at (4,8) blocks Rose/1 (4,5) from Jasmine/2 (4,11). Capturing the Chrysanthemum at (5,9) is legal without the Rose (verified), but here it vacates (4,8) and uncovers the Rose-Jasmine clash.
